ITEM 1 | Mixed leafy greens, dark green and lighter green curly/ruffled leaves with some flat broad leaves, wilted and slightly glossy in places, forming a mound about 12 cm wide and 10 cm tall-spread on the left half of a white square plate, covering roughly 25% of the plate surface | 85
ITEM 2 | Thin julienned orange shreds (carrot-like strips), about 3-5 cm long and 0.3 cm wide, scattered throughout the greens and a few loose on the plate to the right, matte with slight moisture | 6
ITEM 3 | Small dark purple-brown shreds, thin and limp, mixed among the greens near the center of the mound, matte texture | 4
ITEM 4 | Pale off-white small chunks and bits, about 0.5-1 cm, scattered at the edge of the greens and on the plate surface to the right, slightly moist, crumbly | 3
ITEM 5 | Light pale green pale stem pieces, thin and fibrous, one about 4 cm long lying at the bottom edge of the greens, matte | 3
ITEM 6 | Clear to light glossy liquid residue, faint sheen on the plate surface near the greens with minimal pooling, dressing traces | 4
